datasets.name: ExpBatchsDataSet
datasets.sql:
select a.rowid,
       a.id, 
       a.expid, 
       a.kliid, 
       (select  name from customers where id=a.kliid)as sentname,   
       a.filial,
      (select name from filial_t where id=a.filial) as filialname, 
       a.debetaccid,
       a.amount, 
       a.val_cod,
       (select val_name from avalute where valute=a.val_cod) as valname,
       a.trans_ref, 
       a.remit_inf,
       a.countryid,
       a.userid,
       a.username,
       a.senddate, 
       a.senddatetime, 
       a.commituserid,
       a.commitusername,
       a.bkliid, 
       case when a.bkliid is null then  a.bkliname
       else 
      (select  name from customers where id=a.bkliid) end as senttoname,
       a.bfilial,
       case when a.bfilial=-1 then 'Butun filiallar'  else  
      (select name from filial_t where id=a.bfilial)  end as bfilialname, 
       a.kreditaccid, 
       a.badd_inf, 
       a.buserid,
       a.busername, 
       a.password,
       a.vkliid, 
      (select name from customers where id=a.vkliid) as takename, 
       a.vfilial,
       case when a.vfilial=-1 then 'Butun filiallar'  else
      (select name from filial where id=a.vfilial) end as vfilialname, 
       a.vkreditaccid, 
       a.vadd_inf,
       a.vuserid,
       a.takeusername,  
       a.pfattorser, 
       a.pfattornum, 
       a.pfattorbdat,
       a.pfattoredat, 
       a.recdate, 
       a.recdatetime, 
       a.status, 
       a.optype,
       a.setid,
       a.contractno,
       a.bkliname, 
       a.PRICEAMOUNT,
       a.transtype,
       a.countryid,
       a.transfers_accno,
       a.SENDTRANSID,
       a.comissionamount     
from exp_batchs_today a

order by :title

datasets.name: ExpAccDataSet
datasets.sql:
SELECT x.*,v.val_name, a.acc_no, f.NAME
  FROM exp_accounts x, avalute v, ACCOUNT a, Filial f
 WHERE (x.valute = v.valute) AND (x.acc_id = a.id) AND (f.id = x.branchid) and a.close_dat is null
order by x.valute,x.branchid

datasets.name: BranchDataSet
datasets.sql:
SELECT x.*,v.Val_Name, a.Acc_No, f.Name
  FROM Exp_Branchaccount x, Avalute v, Account a, Filial f
 WHERE (x.valute = v.valute) and (x.AccID = a.ID) and (f.ID = x.BranchID)

datasets.name: ReplaceCustDataSet
datasets.sql:
SELECT
   B.TEMPLATEID , B.BOOKMARKNAME , A.FIELDNAME
FROM
   CUSTOMERS_WR_BOOKMARKS B
 , CUSTOMERS_WR_FIELDS A
WHERE
     (B.FIELDID = A.ID)
   AND templateid = :tid
   AND bookmarkname = :bname
